text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross let the crown slip through 
her fingers amidst the brutal battle for 
positioning in the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They praised each other's efforts with 
Gold City, who had also struggled after 
being heavily marked for standing out.
